queries: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS average_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT t.team_id, t.average_win_rate, t.record_count, t.average_win_rate - o.mean_win_rate AS difference_from_mean FROM team_rates AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.average_win_rate IS NULL), difference_from_mean DESC, t.team_id LIMIT 10;

WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_win_rate AS difference FROM team_rates AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
